notes: The options a server owner usually changes, not all of playerbots.conf.dist. default = value in playerbots.conf.dist; default_if_missing = what the code uses when the key is absent; min/max where the code or the meaning bounds the value; coa = option of the Conquest of Azeroth fork; new_in / changed_in compare with 1.7. Every option needs a world server restart, except those whose description in the .dist says ".reload config".

settings.title: Populate the world automatically
settings.description: Random bots log in when the world server starts. Off: only the bots players add themselves.

settings.title: Minimum online bots
settings.description: Lower bound of the random bot population. 500 is what 16 GB of memory holds comfortably; 5,000 bots use about 9 GB of server memory.

settings.title: Maximum online bots
settings.description: Upper bound of the random bot population; more bots use more CPU and memory. Keep it at or above the minimum.

settings.title: Random bot accounts
settings.description: Accounts that hold the random bots; 0 works out how many are needed.

settings.title: Only while players are online
settings.description: Random bots log out when no real player is online and come back when one logs in.

settings.title: Lowest bot level
settings.description: Lowest level of the random bots.

settings.title: Highest bot level
settings.description: Highest level of the random bots (60 is the Conquest of Azeroth level cap).

settings.title: Conquest of Azeroth classes only
settings.description: Random bots are created only in the 21 Conquest of Azeroth classes, never in the nine WotLK classes.

settings.title: "Bot" surname
settings.description: Random bots carry the surname "Bot", so players tell them from real players at a glance.

settings.title: Best gear quality
settings.description: Highest item quality random bots get: 2 uncommon, 3 rare, 4 epic.

settings.title: Item level cap
settings.description: Highest item level random bots wear: 78 matches Molten Core, Onyxia and Zul'Gurub gear; 0 = no limit.

settings.title: Level for epic gear
settings.description: With epic quality allowed, the level from which bots may wear epic gear; below it they keep to rare.

settings.title: Chance of lower gear
settings.description: Chance (0 to 1) that an item of a random bot is one quality lower, so not every bot wears the best gear.

settings.title: Your own characters as bots
settings.description: Players may log their own characters in as bots (.playerbots bot add <name>); they keep their own level and gear.

settings.title: Guild members' characters as bots
settings.description: Players may also add the characters of their guild members as bots.

settings.title: Bots per player
settings.description: How many bots one player may control at the same time.

settings.title: Class bots: automatic setup only
settings.description: Players may only use init=auto on their class bots (rebuilt at their level with matching gear); game masters keep every init= command.

settings.title: Recruited bots of the player's faction
settings.description: Bots recruited by a player (lfg bot, .playerbots coa tank|heal|dps, the SquidBots Lite buttons) are of the player's faction.

settings.title: Player-built raids at a time
settings.description: ".playerbots coa raid" fills the raid of whoever types it with bots; players may only build one while the realm has fewer such raids than this. Game masters have no limit.

settings.title: Minutes between two player raids
settings.description: A player may build one raid of bots every so many minutes.

settings.title: Conquest of Azeroth rotations
settings.description: Each Conquest of Azeroth specialization plays its authored rotation and position; off, bots pick spells on their own only.

settings.title: Smart healing
settings.description: Healers heal whoever is under 25% health first and the tank before the others, and pick the heal for how urgent it is.

settings.title: Smart tanking
settings.description: Tanks take first the enemy on the healer, then the one on whoever is lowest, rather than the nearest.

settings.title: Coordinated interrupts
settings.description: In a group, one bot kicks each enemy cast and the others keep their interrupt for the next one.

settings.title: Boss mechanics
settings.description: Bots read dungeon and raid casts: they step out of point blank casts, cones and areas while the cast bar runs.

settings.title: Keep passive auras
settings.description: A bot whose level or gear is rebuilt keeps its class passives; without it, it lost them until its next login and did far less damage.

settings.title: Healer mana reserve (%)
settings.description: Share of mana a bot that can heal keeps for healing; under it, it stops spending mana on damage. 0 = no reserve.

settings.title: Reliable attack casting
settings.description: Attacks go through the same cast path as heals: a spell refused for a passing reason is retried soon instead of set aside.

settings.title: Specializations bots never play
settings.description: Conquest of Azeroth specialization ids, comma separated; a bot holding one switches to another of its role.

settings.title: Say which spell is avoided
settings.description: Bots say in chat which enemy spell they step out of ("avoiding Rain of Fire"). Off by default: noisy.

settings.title: Join players' dungeon queues
settings.description: Random bots fill the dungeon finder groups of players.

settings.title: Join players' battleground queues
settings.description: Random bots fill the battleground and arena queues of players.

settings.title: Battlegrounds between bots
settings.description: Random bots also start battlegrounds and arenas by themselves, without players.

settings.title: "lfg bot" in chat
settings.description: A player who says "lfg bot heal", "lfg bot tank" or "lfg bot dps" in chat is whispered by free bots of those roles to invite.

settings.title: "lfg bot" level range
settings.description: A bot within this many levels of the player keeps its level and gear; one further away is rebuilt at the player's level.

settings.title: Bots talk
settings.description: Random bots say things in chat now and then.

settings.title: Bot announcements
settings.description: Random bots announce what they do (loot, quests, levels) in the chat channels.

settings.title: "lfg bot" channels
settings.description: Chat channels where bots listen for "lfg bot", comma separated.

settings.title: "lfg bot" reminder (minutes)
settings.description: Every so many minutes, a message to the realm on how to ask the bots. 0 = never.

settings.title: Dashboard status file
settings.description: Path of the bot-status.json snapshot the SquidBots dashboard reads (position, health, activity of every bot). Empty = not written.
